summary: feat(docker): add per-service base image and bundled auth-server image
description:
Because:

- The mono image builds every app and ships all monorepo dependencies;
  per-service images are the first step of the Docker improvement plan.

This commit:

- Adds a root Dockerfile, its dockerignore and docker-bake.hcl for a shared `fxa-base` stage.
- Adds auth-server development and production targets; production runs a webpack bundle with only the npm packages it requires.
- Adds the auth-server webpack config and `bundle` nx target.
- Reads the version and VAPID key JSON files with fs instead of dynamic require.
